home.lede: Trip Plan is your AI travel companion. Describe where you want to go and get a full day-by-day itinerary with real hotel picks, hour-by-hour activities, transport between cities, realistic costs in Euro, and a weather read for every day. Prefer to skip the AI? Build from live Google search results or start blank. Use Explore to research a country or city before you plan, then share the finished trip or sync it to your calendar.
home.feature1Body: Describe your trip once. Get a full day-by-day plan with real hotels, transport options, and activities.
home.feature2Body: Drag blocks between days, swap hotels, and trigger live web searches for flights, stays, and places.

wizard.title: Plan your trip
wizard.originDescription: We use this to estimate the inbound / outbound transport cost and suggest flight options.
wizard.destinationsDescription: Add one or more destinations, in the order you'll travel.
wizard.datesHeading: When are you in each city?
wizard.datesDescription: Set the arrive and leave date for every stop. Nights are auto-calculated. The trip's overall range is derived from these.
wizard.modeSelected: {{mode}} selected — the itinerary will use this to get you there.
wizard.travelersDescription: We use this to multiply meals, activity admissions, and hotel beds correctly.
wizard.advancedDescription: Pick a budget tier and what you care about. Everything else is optional.
wizard.pickSuggestion: Pick one of the suggestions to continue.
wizard.pickSuggestionStop: Pick one of the suggestions to confirm this stop.
wizard.tooSlowBuildSearch: Too slow? Build without AI (Google search)
wizard.anythingElsePlaceholder: e.g. avoid very touristy spots, include a day trip, want to see the northern lights

budget.luxuryDescription: 5-star hotels, fine dining, private tours, business class

import.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://

timeline.empty: No trips with dates to show on the timeline.

packing.title: Packing list

voice.tapToStart: Tap Start and describe your trip.
voice.filled: Wizard filled — review the steps and hit Generate
voice.parseFailed: Could not understand that — try rephrasing

chat.title: Chat with your trip
chat.placeholder: Ask for a change or a suggestion…

chat.example1: Move day 3 to Friday and add a beach afternoon
chat.example2: The Tuesday restaurant is too touristy, swap it for something locals go to

guide.heading: How Trip Plan works
guide.lede: Everything you can do, in order of how most people use it. If you're ever stuck, come back to this page.
guide.stuckBody: Check Settings for cache clearing and rate refresh. Generation usually takes 30–60 seconds; if the progress bar is stuck past 4 minutes, you'll get an option to mark it failed and start over. Your plans always save automatically.

planAi.title: Plan with AI
planAi.body: Walk through 5 quick steps (origin, destinations, dates, travelers, fine-tuning). Claude writes a day-by-day plan with real hotels, specific restaurants, time blocks, and full cost breakdown. Takes about 30–60 seconds.
planAi.tips:
Pick specific cities ("Rome, Italy") rather than regions for best results.
Luxury budget tier gets you Michelin-starred restaurants, 5-star hotels and business-class flights.
You can preset a travel mode per destination (plane/train/etc.) and the AI will honour it.

explore.title: Explore a country or city
explore.body: Before planning a trip, use Explore to get a rich overview: history, must-see highlights, neighborhoods, food, where to stay, things to do, insider tips and what to watch out for. Keeps running in the background if you switch tabs.
explore.tips:
Your Explore history is saved across sessions — click a chip from the sidebar or the Recently Explored list to reopen instantly, no re-fetching.
Every place has an "Open in Maps" link that deep-links into Google Maps.

noAi.title: Build without AI (Google search)
noAi.body: Don't want to wait for AI? The search-based builder composes your plan from live SerpAPI results — real hotel listings for each stay, top-rated places and restaurants for each day, and flight prices origin↔first city. Usually completes in 10–15 seconds.
noAi.tips:
Use this when the AI is slow or when you want results anchored in live prices only.
Every activity card carries the SerpAPI place info (address, rating, hours, phone, website) so you can book immediately.

edit.title: Edit your plan
edit.body: Click Edit on any trip to drag blocks between days, rename them, change times, add/remove costs, swap hotels, delete days, shift the trip dates, or regenerate a single day with custom feedback to Claude. Every edit saves automatically.
edit.tips:
The day progress checklist lets you tick off blocks as you do them during the trip — useful in Today mode.
"Regenerate day" accepts feedback like "more relaxed, less museums, add a sunset viewpoint".
For any block, the More Info button can enrich it with AI or pull live place details (hours, phone, website) from Google.

weather.title: Weather per day
weather.body: Each day shows a compact temperature / condition in the header, plus a detailed weather note at the bottom with a practical advisory (what to wear, whether to pack an umbrella, UV warnings).
weather.tips:
For trips more than 16 days out the forecast falls back to archive data from last year, clearly labeled "typical".
Switch between °C and °F from Settings.

reminders.title: Day-of reminders
reminders.body: Turn on reminders from the top of any trip. You'll get a browser notification the morning of each travel day with that day's title and first activity. Works without any server — uses your browser's notification permission.
reminders.tips:
Only fires once per day per trip.
Clicking the notification jumps straight to the trip.

share.title: Share a trip
share.body: Any trip can be shared via a unique read-only link. Toggle privacy options (hide notes, hide costs) per trip. Recipients don't need to sign in.
share.tips:
The share link stays stable — share once, the recipient always sees the latest version.
Use "Hide costs" when sharing with travel companions who are splitting things themselves.

export.title: Export & calendar sync
export.body: Export a trip as a PDF, plain text, or .ics calendar file — or sync it directly to Google Calendar with one OAuth click. Every day becomes an all-day event and every time block gets its own entry.
export.tips:
PDF export forces all days open so nothing is cut off.
.ics imports into Apple Calendar, Outlook, Fastmail, anything that reads the format.

presence.title: Live presence
presence.body: If someone else is looking at the same trip in their browser (future: shared planning), their avatar appears in the header. Updates every 20 seconds, shows "N viewing".

language.title: English / Serbian
language.body: Toggle between EN and SR in the header or in Settings. AI-generated trips themselves come back in the selected language — day titles, activity descriptions, tips — while keeping real place names in their original form.

install.title: Install as an app
install.body: Trip Plan is a PWA. Install it from Settings for a dedicated app icon and offline support. Previously-viewed maps, weather, and saved trips keep working even without network.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Trips are saved in Firestore under your Google account. Only you can read or edit them. Shared trips are readable by anyone with the link but never editable. Explore history and recent destinations are stored only in your browser's localStorage.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.description: Your personal preferences and account tools.
settings.themeDescription: Dark or light mode for the whole interface.
settings.unitsDescription: Choose how temperatures and distances are displayed.
settings.currencyDescription: All amounts are displayed in Euro by default. Refresh rates if conversions look stale.
settings.cachesDescription: Clear local caches if things look stale or broken.
settings.installDescription: Install Trip Plan to your device for quick access and offline use.
